claims.statement: Whisper trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual and multitask audio supervision, with 117,000 hours covering 96 non-English languages and 125,000 hours of X→en translation data.
confidence_reasons: hard evidence from training data logs
composition verified across multiple dataset components
claims.quote: scaling weakly supervised speech recognition the next order of magnitude to 680,000 hours

claims.statement: Whisper Large V2 achieves 2.7% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean in zero-shot setting.
claims.quote: zero-shot Whisper models have very different robustness properties than supervised LibriSpeech models

claims.statement: Zero-shot Whisper achieves 55.2% relative error reduction compared to supervised LibriSpeech models when evaluated on diverse datasets.
claims.quote: zero-shot Whisper model performs much better on other datasets than expected for its LibriSpeech performance

claims.statement: Whisper's multilingual performance on Fleurs shows strong correlation (r²=0.83) between log training data per language and log WER.
claims.quote: WER halves for every 16× increase in training data

claims.statement: Whisper achieves state-of-the-art 29.1 BLEU on CoVoST2 X→en translation in zero-shot setting without using any CoVoST2 training data.
claims.quote: We achieve a new state of the art of 29.1 BLEU zero-shot

claims.statement: Whisper demonstrates robust performance under noise, outperforming all 14 LibriSpeech-trained baselines under high-noise pub noise conditions (SNR < 10 dB).
confidence_reasons: hard results on controlled noise experiments
claims.quote: all models quickly degrade as the noise becomes more intensive, performing worse than the Whisper model under additive pub noise of SNR below 10 dB

claims.statement: Larger Whisper models show better zero-shot generalization across multilingual, multitask, and translation tasks.
claims.quote: performance continues to increase with model size across multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification

claims.statement: English speech recognition performance shows rapid improvement from 3,000 to 13,000 hours of training data, then slower improvements and saturation approaching human performance.
confidence_reasons: diminishing returns explained by human-level performance limits

claims.statement: Multilingual model scaling follows power-law trend through 54,000 hours then deviates with diminishing returns at 680,000 hours.
Joint multitask and multilingual training shows negative transfer for small models but positive transfer for large models compared to English-only training.
confidence_reasons: hard empirical comparison with controlled compute
claims.quote: multitask and multilingual models scale better and for our largest experiments outperform their English-only counterparts

claims.statement: Whisper's performance on long-form transcription is competitive with commercial ASR systems and outperforms best open-source baselines.
claims.quote: Our model outperforms the best open source model (NVIDIA STT) on all datasets

claims.statement: Whisper achieves near-human accuracy on long-form transcription, with only 1.15% WER difference from computer-assisted human transcription.
claims.quote: Whisper's performance is not perfect but very close to human-level accuracy

claims.statement: Text normalization has substantial impact on WER measurement, with up to 50% WER reduction on some datasets.
confidence_reasons: normalization was jointly developed with model
claims.quote: WER drops of up to 50 percent usually due to a

claims.statement: Whisper training dataset composition is heavily English-biased (65% English) due to internet source selection biases.
claims.quote: our pre-training dataset is currently very English-heavy due to biases of our data collection pipeline

claims.statement: Whisper's approach of scaling weakly supervised pre-training has been underappreciated in speech recognition research.
claims.quote: Whisper suggests that scaling weakly supervised pretraining has been underappreciated so far in speech recognition research

claims.statement: Whisper significantly underperforms on VoxPopuli (13.6% WER) despite strong results on other multilingual benchmarks.
claims.quote: Whisper significantly underperforms prior work and only beats the VP-10K+FT baseline

claims.statement: Long-form transcription performance improves incrementally with each decoding heuristic (beam search, temperature, VAD, previous text, timestamp constraints).
confidence_reasons: hard ablation study with controlled interventions
claims.quote: adding each of the interventions above incrementally reduces the WER

claims.statement: Translation data correlation (r²=0.24) is substantially weaker than speech recognition correlation (r²=0.83), indicating noisier translation training signal.
confidence_reasons: explained by known data quality issues

claims.statement: X→en translation achieves roughly log-linear improvement through 54,000 hours then shows diminishing returns.
Whisper language identification (80.3% on overlapping 82 languages) significantly underperforms supervised SOTA (77.7%) and is upper-bounded by missing language coverage.
claims.quote: Whisper is heavily disadvantaged for language identification on Fleurs, since the Whisper dataset contains no training data for 20 of the 102 languages

limitations.statement: Text normalization was developed jointly with Whisper evaluation, risking overfitting to model-specific transcription patterns.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Comparisons may not reflect true semantic WER but rather normalization effectiveness on Whisper's output patterns
limitations.resolution: Verified against independent FairSpeech normalizer; generally similar but some datasets show substantial differences

limitations.statement: CoVoST2 state-of-the-art claim uses non-standard text normalization that prevents direct comparison.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Claim of SOTA may not hold with standard evaluation protocols
limitations.resolution: Authors acknowledge: 'We caution that we do use a simple text standardizer for this result which prevents direct comparison or claims of SOTA performance'

limitations.statement: Long-form transcription evaluation includes commercial ASR services that may have been trained on some public datasets.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Comparisons may not reflect true relative robustness
limitations.resolution: Authors note: 'some of the commercial ASR systems have been trained on some of these publicly available datasets'

limitations.statement: Human transcription comparison uses only 25 recordings from a single dataset (Kincaid46).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Generalization to other domains and languages unclear
limitations.resolution: Limited sample size for comprehensive human-level performance comparison

limitations.statement: Text normalization impacts vary significantly across datasets (0-50% WER reduction), suggesting dataset-specific effects.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: WER improvements attributed to model may be partially due to evaluation methodology
limitations.resolution: Authors provide code for normalizer to enable reproducible comparison

limitations.statement: Training dataset is English-biased (65% English, most other languages < 1000 hours).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Multilingual performance may be limited by data scarcity for most languages
limitations.resolution: Authors recommend targeted data collection for low-resource languages as future work

limitations.statement: Audio language identification system errors led to misclassified data (e.g., English misidentified as Welsh).
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Some training data quality issues may explain outlier performance on certain languages
limitations.resolution: Issue identified post-hoc through analysis; data filtering could be improved

limitations.statement: VoxPopuli underperformance may be confounded by other models using VoxPopuli in unsupervised pre-training.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Weakness may be relative rather than absolute
limitations.resolution: Authors acknowledge: 'We suspect the underperformance... could be due to other models including this distribution as a major source'

limitations.statement: Long-form transcription relies on heuristics (temperature scheduling, beam search) as workarounds for seq2seq limitations.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Performance dependent on decoding tricks rather than inherent model capability
limitations.resolution: Authors: 'These heuristics serve as a workaround for the noisy predictions of the model'

limitations.statement: Dataset scaling study shows diminishing returns at 680k hours, suggesting possible under-training or saturation.
limitations.effect_on_interpretation: Unclear whether performance is limited by data quantity or quality
limitations.resolution: Authors: 'Further analysis is needed to characterize scaling laws for speech recognition'
